topics.label: Introduction and lecture learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, the course context, and the key learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Foundations of cancer etiology and epidemiological patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the core principles of cancer development by comparing the relative contributions of intrinsic biological processes, inherited genetics, and environmental exposures.

topics.label: Mechanisms of carcinogenic agents and tumor promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the specific biological, chemical, and physical mechanisms through which various agents act as cancer initiators, mutagens, or tumor promoters.

topics.label: Methodologies for assessing carcinogenicity and evaluating risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics present the genomic, epidemiological, animal, and in vitro approaches used to identify carcinogens alongside considerations of exposure risk.

topics.label: Lecture summary and conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding summary and final takeaways of the lecture.
